MESSAGE FROM DANA:
Recommend a creamy dessert I could make with milk or cream.

response.text: Panna cotta is a perfect choice—it’s silky, creamy, and only needs cream, milk, sugar, and gelatin. If you want something even simpler, a stovetop rice pudding with cream and vanilla is cozy and delicious!
